translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Yong mamon kidámin so yong mamon kidámongin banim so umi sung uta ko.
Kale Fedasi so sawa kukumin kinim Yedusalem mo tadbiw keidiw iyo tada tada dek amki Yesus falala dau bom keimom nadiwe
kalomo Yesus nikil iyo itamomo teng wok ban bodongin banim mifiw wanin wanbiw kala.
Kale nadiwo Fedasi so Yu kayak so iyo ilim fasel abem faku bom nadiwo wok teng ban ki boyo wanin wanino, kalesiwo.

Kale ika wanin sánin báno tadiw ayo wanin wanodiw banim, kata alam teng wok ban asik boyo kuw wananáliw. Kale imi fasel kukuw ayo seng fakuyábiw ayo wok ket kaw, fadet gingabiwe uyo ulum leiw kukum kukum kanamaliw.
Kayo Fedasi so sawa kukumin kinim so iyo Yesus dákadá bakodaw, “watawo kale kami weng kidimin kinim iyo num fasel kukuw abo nadiw teng wok ban bodongin banim mifiw wanin wanbiwe?” Akiwe,

Yesus asik weng bakoyam, “fong awangal kiba, lum senin kinim Aiseya ayo kimi guton godu bako nadano, ‘wanang kinim bo sák bon tem weng uta Got win kufádawábiw. Kata imi Got aket fukanin ayo sikam bom nadiwade
bisok nam win uta kufámuw kaí, kal bom nadiwe ilita sawa kidel ku kuku bom beta Got ami sawa kaí kalanaliw.’ Yakeisa.
Kale kiba Got ami sawa uyo dew yak kaek kuti nadiwade kilim fasel kukuw uta kuw kidi kudew tabesiw.”
Yesus sawil kuek diyam bakoyam, “kibilim aket tetin kidel bom nadiw bude ken Got weng sawa buta kudew yak kinang teibiw kuw kilim sawa uta faku kuku bom keimaliw.
Wataw bá, Mosus sawa bako nadale, ‘kakun so kalaw so win kufámin’ ade ‘kan kinim ata akune, alawe gán abuyama namti, anbidiw fikalanámin kuwo.’ Kalesa.
Kata kiba kukuyam nadiwe, ‘kinim mak am akun so alaw so dakoyam kisol mak kuyamokaba be, ‘Koban’ imi mit be Got amino kalin ko.
Kale beta kanamom nadiw leiw akeiyamiw yakno yakno akun alaw dakoyamodiw banim keisiw.
Kale beta kanamom nadiwade beta kilim fasel kukuw kaí, kale nadiwade Got weng uta kudák tabid kudá ausiw. Kale kukuw kalak alataw alataw be ki faku unsiw kala.” Yakeisa ko.

Alo Yesus ayo kanomin wanang kinim iyo gán dáyama tad atamiwe, aka bakoyam, “adikum kiba nam weng kidinam nadiwade kal keidin kala. Mew ufek ufek bu uyo mak yak dák kinim kidin tem une bu bo kinim daw mafak dádomu banim.
Kata afan bon tem leiw kabadáko matam be tadebu uta ta bom kinim ayo daw mafak dákabu kala.
Kan ata ken so namti weng bela kidela kidilako!”
Kalbane, Yesus ayo wanang kinim imadá wakas tam am mak unane alam weng kidimin kinim iyo weng fakom weng bakoda uyo dákadá bakodawiwe,
aka bakoyam, “kiba aket dakwayam bene? Mew ufek ufek abiw kalo dák kinim kidin tem unebu, bo daw mafak dádomu banim kala.
Kaleyo buyo ki dák aket tem unebu bá, buyo ki dák mat tem abe nadule ulum leiw dák abe unemábu kala.” (Kaleyo Yesus ami kanamin weng bakosa uyo mew wanin bo mak so abem bu bá.)
Yesus ayo weng be kuek tane baka bom nadale “yaknámin uta aket temo matam bon tem leiw fakelbu namti, uta ta bom kinim daw mafak dádokabu ka.
Kaleyo aket tem kabadák kalo aket tetin mafak tadebu uyo ki, bis gam keiyámin, kinim wanang dikin sakadinin, sák ait iluyámin, yakot wanin,
ibakamin, kinim atam liwin, titiyámin kukuw, mak imi ufek ufek mok mokin, win kufámin, kukuw mafak faku biyámin,
adikum bidi kalami kukuw mafak wanang kinim kidin temo tademala uta ta bom kinim daw mafak dákamábu ka.” Yakeisa ko.
Mifiw wanang umi aket afan kalin sung uta ko.
Kale Yesus ayo buwák kudá nadale una ki yak bakan mak ayo abiw dukum Taya kal tam am mak wanang kinim kal keidoliwo kale iwál tam una, kata ken wána teinoma banim.
Kale kanamano wanang mak uka Yesus am sung uyo kidi naduno um mun uyo sinik mafak tabe gei kusano. Kale uka tad Yesus yán mewso kutin dák abesu.
Wanang uka Gadík wanang Saidin bakan Filisiya abiw kal kusiwo. Kale uka Yesus mun dawtadelaw bom nadule bako, “yak nam mun sinik mafak gei kusa uyo takan keimalo!” Ak buduno,
aka bakomam, “kamakikiw Isadael man iyo imadáliw wanin asik waniwo kalin ta. Man imi imin uyo mayan akiwin bá.” Wakane,
uka bako nadune, “au, Kamokim bude, kata mayan ika akum mit mit bum dá bom man wanin but but sikel budu wanan unbiw.” Akune,
Aka bakomam, “unalo, kum mun uyo sinik mafak bá umadála, watawo kaleyo bá, kum weng dam bakodaw kayo ka.”
Wakane, uka yak tam am tam somo mun kai, abin akálbuno kalomo sinik mafak ayo umadála ka. Kalesu ko.
Yesus kinim kentát ade weng kabom kidel dausa umi sung uta ko.
Kale Yesus ayo Taya bakan bo kudá Saiddon bakan fako bá kuw yak Galili mik fako yak abiw Nangal kal unsa.
Kale kinim so wanang so ika kinim kentát ade weng kabom mak dew tad Yesus dádaw nadiwe mun dádaw, “teng dew yak dawti malelawalo!” Akiwe,
aka kinim ayo alafin dew yak kaek tei, wanang kinim kin umayam nadale aka sikal dil kilung tem tadelaw bá kuw, beta kasuk fadet kale nadale yak falang malelaw kei nadale
aka katam fen abid tikin kin modano aket budunin weng mak bakodaw nadane, “efafata” kalesa. Umi mit uyo ki ‘bádalo kalin.’
Kale afan kinim ayo ken dakat kalune falang uyo fong kalune kal weng ifiw banim bakamsa ko.
Yesus ayo weng anuyam kinim wanang mak bakayamin báno kal bom nadale seng kuw im tam mansa. Kata itane kidilodiw banim ulum kanom sun kuw takensiw.

Wanang kinim atamiw iyo bako, “kolo be so kuwo.” Kale bako nadiwade “aka mew ufek ufek bo adikum ken kuw kanaba beta ka. Aka kentát, kata kidel dauda weng ken kidi bom ade weng kabom, kata kidel dauda weng baka bom keibano.” Kalsiw ko.
